row.problem_statement:
# Jaccard similarity calculation fails with AttributeError

## Description

The Jaccard similarity implementation in strsimpy is broken. When trying to calculate the similarity between two strings, it raises an AttributeError.

## Reproduction

Here's a simple example that reproduces the issue:

```python
from strsimpy.jaccard import Jaccard

jaccard = Jaccard(1)

# These calls will fail
s1 = "Shanghai"
s2 = "ShangHai"
similarity = jaccard.similarity(s1, s2)
distance = jaccard.distance(s1, s2)
```

When running this code, you'll get an AttributeError. The issue appears to be related to how the profile sets are handled in the similarity calculation.

I tried with different string inputs and k-values, but the error persists. The problem seems to be in the implementation of the similarity method, where it's trying to use union and intersection operations on objects that don't support these methods.

This is a regression from previous versions where the Jaccard similarity calculation worked correctly.
